divergence: Mixed (T2 passes; T0, T1 fail). All three runs' scans surfaced the five core matters and the three portfolio-company series. They split at the first screening stage: T2 listed all 26 series matters and ran snippet scripts and reads across every series before writing; T0 read one or two members per series and later one document each for a few more, so eight members appear only as generic ranges and one is misdescribed; T1 read only the five core matters and reported nothing else. The screening reviews in T0 and T1 named the unopened series members specifically; T0 acted partly, T1 not at all. T0's many agent-declared stages (scans, fact checks, consistency checks) did not reach the unopened matters.
